_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json; ADR-031 declarative-first; ADR-022 real OpenRegister ObjectService API only
_meta.description: Tier 3 — Dual GAAP reporting (IFRS naast Nederlandse Richtlijnen voor de Jaarverslaggeving). Adds six declarative schemas: AccountingFramework (REQ-DGAAP-001), ChartOfAccountsMapping (REQ-DGAAP-002), DualTransaction (REQ-DGAAP-003/006), ReconciliationBridge (REQ-DGAAP-005/006), StandardSpecificCalculation (REQ-DGAAP-004/005) and FrameworkElection (REQ-DGAAP-007/010). Parallel-ledger journal materialisation books every transaction under BOTH RJ and IFRS, classifies the divergence per standard (LEASE_IFRS16, PENSION_IAS19, ECL_IFRS9, REVENUE_IFRS15, IMPAIRMENT_IAS36, BORROWING_COST_IAS23, DEFERRED_TAX_IAS12, BUSINESS_COMBINATION_IFRS3), and explodes the RJ-to-IFRS bridge per period. The bulk of the surface is declarative metadata: x-openregister-lifecycle drives DualTransaction (open → classified → reconciled) and FrameworkElection (draft → active → superseded); x-openregister-aggregations documents the reconciliation-bridge roll-up. A single ADR-031 exception-path guard (OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\DualGaapGuard) enforces the two cross-field preconditions the declarative DSL cannot yet express: a DualTransaction may only be reconciled once it carries a divergence reason code AND (for temporary differences) a deferred-tax effect, and a FrameworkElection may only activate once its comply-or-explain motivation and AVA-besluit reference are present and the elected variant matches the measured size criteria. Seed objects ship five worked examples (lease IFRS-16, pension IAS-19, ECL IFRS-9, deferred-tax temporary difference and a framework election) per design.md.

AccountingFramework.title: Accounting Framework
AccountingFramework.description: A financial-reporting framework (IFRS-EU, NL-GAAP-RJ, US-GAAP) with its version, effective date, jurisdictions, regulator, base currency and statement templates (REQ-DGAAP-001). The basis for parallel-ledger materialisation: every GL posting is booked under each active framework.

version.description: Framework version year (the standards edition in force).
version.title: Version

effectiveDate.description: Date from which this framework version applies (ISO-8601).
effectiveDate.title: Effective Date

jurisdictions.description: ISO-3166 country codes where this framework applies.
jurisdictions.title: Jurisdictions

statementTemplates.description: Identifiers of the financial-statement templates this framework drives (e.g. IAS-1, BW2-model-A).
statementTemplates.title: Statement Templates

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads are scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-DGAAP-001).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

ChartOfAccountsMapping.title: Chart of Accounts Mapping
ChartOfAccountsMapping.description: Maps a source (RJ) account to one or more target (IFRS) accounts with an allocation rule (REQ-DGAAP-002). Supports one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one and recharacterization cardinalities; activation is blocked until a test-data reconciliation reaches ≥95% coverage or an explicit exception justification is recorded.

sourceAccount.description: Source RJ account number (FK to Account.accountNumber) (REQ-DGAAP-002).
sourceAccount.title: Source Account

targetAccounts.description: Target IFRS account numbers this source account maps to (FK to Account.accountNumber).
targetAccounts.title: Target Accounts

allocationRule.description: How the source amount is split over the target accounts.
allocationRule.title: Allocation Rule

allocationDetail.description: The concrete allocation (e.g. percentage split or formula expression such as ROU = PV(future_lease_payments, IBR)).
allocationDetail.example: ROU = PV(future_lease_payments, IBR); liability_current = next 12 months; liability_noncurrent = remainder
allocationDetail.title: Allocation Detail

effectiveFrom.description: Date from which the mapping applies (ISO-8601).
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

effectiveTo.description: Date the mapping ceases to apply; null while open-ended.
effectiveTo.title: Effective To

coveragePercent.description: Percentage of existing RJ mutations the mapping converts successfully on the validation test-run (REQ-DGAAP-002). Activation requires ≥95 unless an exception is documented.
coveragePercent.title: Coverage Percent

exceptionJustification.description: Approver justification when coverage is below 95% (REQ-DGAAP-002).
exceptionJustification.title: Exception Justification

approver.description: User id of the group-accountant who approved the mapping.
approver.title: Approver

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-DGAAP-002).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

DualTransaction.title: Dual Transaction
DualTransaction.description: Links one base GL transaction to its parallel RJ and IFRS journal entries, with the divergence amount, reason code and permanence classification (REQ-DGAAP-003, REQ-DGAAP-006). Auto-populated on GL materialisation; the group-accountant may override the classification with an audit-trail reason. Lifecycle: open → classified → reconciled.

baseTransactionId.description: FK to the base GLTransaction both ledgers derive from (REQ-DGAAP-003).
baseTransactionId.title: Base Transaction ID

rjJournalEntries.description: Journal lines booked under the RJ ledger.
rjJournalEntries.title: Rj Journal Entries

ifrsJournalEntries.description: Journal lines booked under the IFRS ledger.
ifrsJournalEntries.title: Ifrs Journal Entries

divergenceAmount.description: Absolute value of the divergence between the RJ and IFRS treatment, in the administration currency (REQ-DGAAP-003).
divergenceAmount.title: Divergence Amount

divergenceReasonCode.description: Standard-specific reason for the divergence (REQ-DGAAP-003). Empty/absent while the transaction is still being classified.
divergenceReasonCode.title: Divergence Reason Code

divergenceClassification.description: Permanence of the divergence; temporary differences drive deferred tax under IAS 12 (REQ-DGAAP-006).
divergenceClassification.title: Divergence Classification

deferredTaxEffect.description: Deferred-tax impact of a temporary difference (amount × statutory rate); zero for permanent differences and reclassifications (REQ-DGAAP-006).
deferredTaxEffect.title: Deferred Tax Effect

classificationOverridden.description: True when a group-accountant manually overrode the auto-classification (REQ-DGAAP-003).
classificationOverridden.title: Classification Overridden

overrideReason.description: Audit-trail reason for a manual classification override (REQ-DGAAP-003).
overrideReason.title: Override Reason

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-DGAAP-003).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

open.label: Open
open.description: Materialised under both ledgers; divergence not yet classified.

classified.label: Classified
classified.description: Divergence reason code and permanence assigned (auto or manual override).

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Included in a period ReconciliationBridge; deferred-tax effect recorded where the difference is temporary.

classify.label: Classify divergence
classify.description: Assign the divergence reason code and permanence (REQ-DGAAP-003).

reconcile.label: Mark reconciled
reconcile.description: Include in the period bridge; requires a reason code and (for temporary differences) a deferred-tax effect (REQ-DGAAP-006).

reopen.label: Reopen for reclassification
reopen.description: Return to open to revise the divergence classification (REQ-DGAAP-003).

ReconciliationBridge.title: Reconciliation Bridge
ReconciliationBridge.description: The RJ-to-IFRS conversion for one period and metric (equity or net result): opening RJ balance, adjustments per standard, tax effect per jurisdiction and closing IFRS balance (REQ-DGAAP-005, REQ-DGAAP-006). A declarative aggregation over the period's reconciled DualTransactions; each adjustment line is drill-down navigable to its StandardSpecificCalculation and GL entries (REQ-DGAAP-008).

openingBalanceRj.description: Opening RJ balance for the metric (REQ-DGAAP-005).
openingBalanceRj.title: Opening Balance Rj

adjustments.description: Bridging adjustments per IFRS standard (description, amount, account, standardReference, standardCalculationId).
adjustments.title: Adjustments

totalTemporaryDifferences.description: Sum of temporary differences in the period (REQ-DGAAP-006).
totalTemporaryDifferences.title: Total Temporary Differences

totalPermanentDifferences.description: Sum of permanent differences in the period (REQ-DGAAP-006).
totalPermanentDifferences.title: Total Permanent Differences

taxEffect.description: Deferred-tax effect per jurisdiction (jurisdiction, amount, statutoryRate) (REQ-DGAAP-006).
taxEffect.title: Tax Effect

approver.description: User id who signed off the bridge.
approver.title: Approver

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-DGAAP-005).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

bridgeByPeriodStandard.description: Declarative shape of the reconciliation-bridge roll-up (REQ-DGAAP-005, REQ-DGAAP-006). Groups reconciled DualTransactions by (period, divergenceReasonCode) within an administration and framework pair, sums the divergence amounts per standard into adjustments[], sums temporary vs. permanent differences, and derives closingBalanceIfrs = openingBalanceRj + sum(adjustments). Deferred-tax effect is summed per jurisdiction from each temporary DualTransaction's deferredTaxEffect. When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the cross-schema join for per-jurisdiction tax effect, the same result is computed from the real ObjectService API (find/findAll).

StandardSpecificCalculation.title: Standard-Specific Calculation
StandardSpecificCalculation.description: The supporting calculation behind a divergence: IFRS-16 incremental borrowing rate, IAS-19 projected-unit-credit, IFRS-9 expected-credit-loss staging, IFRS-15 revenue model (REQ-DGAAP-004, REQ-DGAAP-005). Stores inputs, outputs, revaluation frequency, actuary/validator signoff (IAS 19) and an audit-evidence URI to the source document (e.g. an actuarial report in docudesk).

contractOrPositionReference.description: Reference to the contract / position the calculation concerns (lease ref, plan id, customer segment).
contractOrPositionReference.title: Contract Or Position Reference

inputs.description: Calculation inputs (free-form JSON: discount rate, demographic tables, future lease payments, aging buckets, macro overlays).
inputs.title: Inputs

outputs.description: Calculation outputs (free-form JSON: ROU asset, liability split, service cost, ECL by stage).
outputs.title: Outputs

revaluationFrequency.description: How often the calculation is re-run (REQ-DGAAP-005).
revaluationFrequency.title: Revaluation Frequency

lastCalculatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last calculation run (ISO-8601).
lastCalculatedAt.title: Last Calculated At

actuarySignoff.description: Actuary / validator who signed off the calculation (required for IAS 19) (REQ-DGAAP-004).
actuarySignoff.title: Actuary Signoff

auditEvidenceUri.description: URI to the source evidence document (e.g. docudesk:// actuarial report) (REQ-DGAAP-008).
auditEvidenceUri.title: Audit Evidence URI

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-DGAAP-004).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

FrameworkElection.title: Framework Election
FrameworkElection.description: Records a legal entity's primary-framework election with comply-or-explain motivation, RJ variant, measured size criteria and AVA-besluit reference (REQ-DGAAP-007, REQ-DGAAP-010). Lifecycle: draft → active → superseded. Activation requires a motivation, an AVA-besluit reference and a variant consistent with the measured size criteria; the system warns when criteria breach the threshold for two consecutive years.

legalEntityId.description: FK to the legal entity this election applies to (REQ-DGAAP-010).
legalEntityId.title: Legal Entity ID

complyOrExplainMotivation.description: Comply-or-explain motivation for the election (e.g. small-entity exemption BW2 art 2:396) (REQ-DGAAP-010).
complyOrExplainMotivation.example: Kleine rechtspersoon op basis van BW2 art 2:396.
complyOrExplainMotivation.title: Comply Or Explain Motivation

sizeCriteriaBalanceSheetTotal.description: Measured balance-sheet total used for the size test (REQ-DGAAP-010).
sizeCriteriaBalanceSheetTotal.title: Size Criteria Balanstotaal

sizeCriteriaNetRevenue.description: Measured net turnover used for the size test (REQ-DGAAP-010).
sizeCriteriaNetRevenue.title: Size Criteria Netto Omzet

sizeCriteriaAverageEmployees.description: Measured average headcount used for the size test (REQ-DGAAP-010).
sizeCriteriaAverageEmployees.title: Size Criteria Gemiddeld Werknemers

sizeCriteriaBreachYears.description: Number of consecutive years the size criteria have breached the variant threshold; a value ≥2 triggers a warning (REQ-DGAAP-010).
sizeCriteriaBreachYears.title: Size Criteria Breach Years

avaDecisionReference.description: Reference to the AVA (general meeting) resolution recording the election (REQ-DGAAP-010).
avaDecisionReference.title: Ava Besluit Reference

effectiveFrom.description: Date from which the election applies (ISO-8601).
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

effectiveTo.description: Date the election ceases to apply; null while active.
effectiveTo.title: Effective To

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration (REQ-DGAAP-010).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Election being prepared; motivation and AVA reference may be incomplete.

active.label: Active
active.description: The entity's effective framework election; blocks publication of statements inconsistent with it (REQ-DGAAP-010).

superseded.label: Superseded
superseded.description: Replaced by a later election effective from a new date.

activate.label: Activate election
activate.description: Activate once the motivation, AVA-besluit reference and a variant consistent with the measured size criteria are present (REQ-DGAAP-010).

supersede.label: Supersede
supersede.description: Supersede when a later election takes effect (REQ-DGAAP-007).

objects.allocationDetail: ROU = PV(future_lease_payments, IBR); liability_current = next 12 months; liability_noncurrent = remainder

objects.complyOrExplainMotivation: Kleine rechtspersoon op basis van BW2 art 2:396; geen beursnotering.
